$comment: One line of an independent review event log review_log.jsonl (docs/dev/independent-review-spec.md section 5.4): {seq, prev_sha256, event, time, data}. seq starts at 0; prev_sha256 is all zeros for seq 0 and otherwise the canonical SHA-256 of the previous line's record; time is the command's --now or the clock. The key fields of each event's data are Python rules in contracts/review.py (EVENT_FIELDS, event_problems); the data of an observed event follows review_observation.json. filter_needed (contracts 3.4.0) creates the filter slot of the optional filtering pass.
